subject: mmenu, work when run in rstudio but not work with shiny-server pro

messages.author: caa102fbfd924ff6
messages.subject: mmenu, work when run in rstudio but not work with shiny-server pro
parts:
Hi,
I was trying to use mmenu ( http://mmenu.frebsite.nl/ ) in our shiny app.
I got it to work when I run it in rstudio,
However, it not working under shiny-server pro.
Does anyone have some idea on this problem? 

library(shiny)
library(shinyBS)
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  tags$head(
    includeScript(path="www/jQuery.mmenu-master/dist/js/jquery.mmenu.all.min.js"),
    tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", type = "text/css", href = "jQuery.mmenu-master/dist/css/jquery.mmenu.all.css"),
    tags$link(rel="shortcut icon", href="www/favicon.ico")
  ),
  tags$script(type="text/javascript",
              "$(document).ready(function() {
                  $(\"#my-menu\").mmenu({
                 
                  });
                  var API = $(\"#my-menu\").data( \"mmenu\" );
                  $(\"#my-button\").click(function() {
                      API.open();
                  });
                });
              "),
  tags$div(id="page",
           tags$div(class="wrapper",
                    tags$a(onclick="$(\"#my-menu\").data( \"mmenu\" ).open();",id="my-button",icon("bars",class="fa-3x"))
                    )
           ),
  tags$nav(id="my-menu",
           tags$ul(
             tags$li(tags$span("input"),
                     tags$div(
                         selectizeInput("parcelvar","fdsafds",choices = c(1,2,32,14,421),selected = 1),
                         selectizeInput("parcelvar2","fdsafds",choices = c(1,2,32,14,421),selected =1)
                     )
                     ),
             tags$li(
               tags$span("Buttons"),
               tags$ul(tags$li(tags$a("testsearch")),
                       tags$li(
                         tags$span(bsButton("allParcelsShown", "Show All Parcels", icon = icon("map"), type = "toggle", value = TRUE))
                       ),
                       tags$li(
                         tags$span(bsButton("filteredParcelsShown", "Show Filtered Parcels", icon = icon("map"), type = "toggle", value = TRUE))
                       )
               )
             ),
             tags$li(
               tags$span("Miles From Substation",numericInput("dist","",value="20"))
             )
           )
  )
))

messages.author: dc3c7e88d9ea3297
messages.subject: Re: mmenu, work when run in rstudio but not work with shiny-server pro
parts:
For those interested, it looks like mmenu relies upon a newer version of jQuery, so this fixes it:

library(shiny)
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  suppressDependencies("jquery"),
  tags$script(src="jquery-2.2.1.js"),
  tags$script(src="jQuery.mmenu-master/dist/js/jquery.mmenu.all.min.js"),

messages.subject: Re: mmenu, work when run in rstudio but not work with shiny-server pro
parts:
Wow, please ignore that reply it's flat-out wrong. I submitted a ticket with RStudio but I'll go ahead and list it here as well since it's urgent:

We are working the implement a jQuery based navigation system in Shiny (mmenu.frebsite.nl). The code is here: https://github.com/zhongxiali/mmenuShinyTest. However it does not work on a shiny server, as shown here: https://zhongxia.shinyapps.io/mmenu/. It appears that something in shinyapps.js (or shiny-server-pro.js) is overriding the capability to click on a menu to drill down to a submenu and instead it appends the selected menu to the URL.

Chris
